architecture_summary: Modular React SPA. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Routing via React Router. State: local component state + context for auth/user. Styling: CSS modules. API calls: fetch wrapper. No Redux (YAGNI).

tickets.title: Build Dashboard Home page (screen_1_dashboard_home)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Extract reusable widgets (announcements, quick actions, progress cards). Keep layout exact. Use CSS modules for styling. Mock data for now. API integration later.

tickets.title: Build Homework Search page (screen_2_homework_search)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Implement search bar, filters, results list. Use controlled components for form inputs. Debounce search input. Mock data for results.
acceptance_criteria: Exact visual match to Stitch screen
Empty state shown when no results

tickets.title: Build Calendar & Exams Schedule page (screen_3_calendar_exams_schedule)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Implement calendar view (use react-big-calendar or similar if already installed, else native HTML/CSS). Show exams as events. Mock data for events.
acceptance_criteria: Exact visual match to Stitch screen
Calendar shows current month by default
Exams appear as events with correct date/time
Click event shows exam details (modal or inline)
Responsive (mobile: list view, desktop: calendar grid)

tickets.title: Build Transaction Detail page (detail_transaksi)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Show transaction details (amount, date, items, status). Mock data for now. Add print/download button (UI only, no actual functionality).
acceptance_criteria: Exact visual match to Stitch screen

tickets.title: Create shared layout components (Header, Sidebar, Footer)
tickets.description: Extract common layout elements from Stitch screens. Build Header (logo, user menu), Sidebar (navigation), Footer. Use CSS modules. Make responsive (sidebar collapses on mobile).

tickets.title: Set up routing and app shell (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Configure React Router. Create routes for all pages (DashboardHome, HomeworkSearch, CalendarExams, TransactionDetail). Add 404 page. Wrap app in Layout component. Set up error boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Error boundary catches rendering errors (shows fallback UI)
Router uses lazy loading for pages (ponytail: skip for now, add when bundle size > 200KB)
